svg.title: Measuring an image
svg.desc: Software sends 50 image bytes. The hardware writes the 0x80 marker, five zero bytes and the length, 400 bits, then hashes the block and extends the measurement register.
svg.text: Measuring an image: software sends bytes, hardware pads
One 64-byte SHA-256 block for a 50-byte image. Software cannot write the marker, the zeros or the length, so it cannot choose what is hashed.
Everything not blue is written by hardware, from the count
